capability.name: Look up member savings balance
capability.description: Given a member reference, return the member's current savings account balance and display name.

inputs.name: member_ref
inputs.description: The identifier used to locate the member. On northridge this is the five-digit member ID.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's savings account

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Member display name, returned for caller verification

member_ref_field.description: Member identifier input on the search form

chain.notes: Second textbox on the search form, after Last Name. Position only.

member_ref_field.notes: CoreServ provides no label binding; the accessible name is inferred by the perception layer from the preceding table cell (name_source=preceding_td). The label text is tenant-specific, which is why this element is the primary overlay target.

search_submit.description: Submit button on the member search form
search_submit.notes: A button named 'Submit' also exists in the nav frame's Quick Lookup form. The frame qualifier is what disambiguates them, not the name.

results_grid.description: The search results grid, identified by its leading column header
results_grid.notes: The results table itself carries no accessible name, so its presence is asserted via a column header instead. The header text is tenant-specific.

results_view_link.description: The View link in the results row for the requested member

chain.name: View
chain.notes: Ambiguous whenever the result set has more than one row

results_view_link.notes: Every row's link is identically named 'View'; the containing row is the only thing that distinguishes them. Scoping on {{member_ref}} works in both tenants because each tenant's results grid displays whichever identifier that tenant searches by.

member_detail_heading.description: Page heading confirming the member detail screen loaded
member_detail_heading.notes: Rendered as a table cell, not a heading element -- CoreServ has no semantic landmarks. Role is 'cell' because that is what perception actually reports.

savings_balance_cell.description: Balance value in the account row whose type is Savings
savings_balance_cell.notes: The accounts table is tenant-independent, so this element needs no per-tenant override.

member_name_cell.description: Value cell of the Name row in the member detail field table
member_name_cell.notes: The detail field table is a label/value layout with no column headers at all, so this rung addresses the value cell by position within its row. column_index is scoped to a content-matched row, which is why it is medium rather than brittle.

outcomes.name: member_not_found
outcomes.message: No member exists with the supplied identifier.

outcomes.name: permission_denied
outcomes.message: The member record exists but is restricted.

provenance.goal: Look up member 10001 and read their current savings balance
provenance.notes: Hand-written to fix the target format before the replay engine is built. Element names were taken from evidence/a11y_diagnostic/ rather than guessed: the search field, results grid and detail heading all report the names recorded here.
